The evaluation of quantitative metrics and human judgements are used in our experiments. Specifically, quantitative metrics contains traditional metrics, such as PPL and BLEU score , and Distinct  metric which is recently proposed to evaluate the degree of diversity of the generated responses by calculating the number of distinct unigrams and bigrams in the generated responses.
